provenance.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. One standalone empty hanging daily gift calendar card for Puff Trails, matching card shape in supplied Daily Rewards board. Vertical rounded pennant with gently pointed bottom, thick pearly lavender rim, opaque pale lavender inset, blank glossy deep purple pill header at top, single small gold hanging loop at top center. Front-on symmetric. Empty center and empty header: no text, no day numbers, no currency, no stars, no character, no reward icon. Entire object visible with 10 percent margins. Rounded plush-inspired glossy enamel game UI, cream and lavender highlights, warm gold hardware. Genuine transparent RGBA outside card, opaque card interior; no background, no haze, no floor, no rope connecting to another card. One reusable empty component only.
